minor.issue: Cross-league duplicate check: dup_query uses {owner_id, item_type, player_id} but does NOT include league_id. If an owner has the same player on the trade block in League A, attempting to add that player in League B returns 400 'Already on trade block'. Discovered when chriszarek's POST for Connor McDavid in Ice Kings failed because he had McDavid on the block in a different league. Recommend: add league_id (and team_id) to dup_query so the same player can be on different teams' trade blocks across leagues. Pre-existing — not caused by this iteration's fixes.
